screen_corners.method: Measured on src.png (2688x1520) in the Higgsfield sandbox: red-case mask, screen = the non-red area inside the case hull (black glass plus its thin black bezel), straight lines fitted to the middle 60% of each of the four glass edges (residual 0.24 to 0.36 px), corners = the line intersections. The glass has rounded corners, so these are the virtual sharp corners for a rounded-rectangle HTML element mapped with matrix3d; the visible rounded tips sit 6 to 18 px inside them (screen_corners_rounded_tips). Labels follow the spec's reading direction: the screen's top edge is the far long edge, so the notification reads left to right along the phone's long axis. Overlay check: rev/screen_overlay.jpg and rev/corners_grid.jpg.

top_left.where: far end of the left short edge (the topmost screen corner in the frame)

top_right.where: far end of the right short edge (the rightmost screen corner, under the warm sheen)
